title: Over 50 Houthi Fighters Killed in Three Days of Marib Clashes
detail: Yemeni government forces and allied militias fought heavy clashes with Houthi fighters on multiple fronts around Marib between September 19 and 21, 2026, with military sources reporting more than 50 Houthi fighters killed over the three-day period. Government forces advanced on the Al-Mashjah front west of Marib city, forcing a Houthi retreat and destroying several vehicles, while fighting also continued on the Kahboub front — overlooking the Bab al-Mandeb approaches — where the Giant Brigades militia claimed to have destroyed Houthi artillery and anti-aircraft positions and killed two Iran-aligned militia commanders. Houthi sources alleged more than two dozen Saudi airstrikes in a single 24-hour period; separate Saudi airstrikes on Al-Jawf were reported to have killed 4. Despite the heavy exchanges, neither side made significant territorial gains.

media.caption: Government forces and Houthi fighters clash over Marib province

confidenceReason: Houthi fighter casualty count is a government/allied-militia claim without independent verification; Saudi airstrike counts are disputed between Houthi and coalition sources.
